spectral_scattering.input: Current T1 native long/short logpower float16->float32, no resizing, fixed coefficients, all paths mean/std spatial grid

config.selection: Valonly. First all V1 guards: original Single within5pp,originalACC within1.5pp,originalDouble/background and10ACC within1pp; each of6background ACC within2pp. Then six-condition mean((Single+Double)/2),six-condition meanACC,min(six-condition meanSingle,meanDouble),originalACC. V1epoch0legalbest. NegativeSNRs included. Never rank onTest/Single>Double/monotonicity.
config.early_stop: Both arms min20,max40 matched totalepochs; stop jointly only when both have no protected primary balance gain>=0.2pp for10epochs. Save actual best rank independently; minor bestscore refresh does not necessarily reset patience. Fixedlr/AdamW. Restorebest including epoch0.
config.training: Both continue identical retainedV1(global51); complete publicTabM adapts, fixed dual scattering and source Train normalization. Only SNRsampling changes. Formal storedwaveforms allclasses; noSingleenvelope,no new losses/modules/views. Seed13; exact old order[13,700,globalepoch],SNR[13,100,globalepoch,index],Gaussian[13,101,globalepoch,index],dropout13+globalepoch*100000+step. Same original class budgets,CE+0.1count.
config.reuse: P50 first20 epochs/state/optimizer from matching A_continue. Rescore all20Valhistory using locked newrule; savedepoch20 must be selected,otherwise reuse rejected. Check savedA20 on all6Val before using. P25 starts identicalV1/freshAdamW. Fromepoch21 both advance together to same stop. No old Testscore selects weight.
config.adoption: Among predeclared P25/P50 choose highest protected Valrank only if gain over V1: six-condition balance>=1pp and mean(-5,-10)ACC>=2pp; otherwise retainV1. Always report both finalists six-conditionTest after Val seal.
